title: 红桥河 Hongqiao He
subtitle: a canal · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: a band 8 m wide on the ground. Its shape follows the source named under Where. The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Rainbow Bridge River, south of the gate, to the 清河

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a canal outside the garden walls

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: from 畅春园's NW corner east to today's 万泉河 (osm way 23426825) along 39.996 south of the gardens, then its course NE to the 清河; today's channel taken as the old line

facts.label: Note
facts.value: [j99:26a-26b] 從暢春園西北門五空閘流出垣外在圓明園宫門之南迤邐東注, east past a stone bridge, to the 清河 and 沙河. Wolseley p.228-230 (1860): 'the little river, which sweeps round the southern face of the park', feeds the lotus ponds, 'several pretty granite bridges'. The guards' seal office stood at 红桥河 [j72:33a].
